chapterInfo.content:
18
Ɛsɛ obiara sɛ ɔsoa ɔno ara n’asodie
1Na AWURADE asɛm baa me nkyɛn sɛ: 2#Yer 31.29 Mokyerɛ sɛn, sɛ mobu bɛ yi Israel asase so sɛ: Agyanom twɛre abunu, na mma se fem, a? 3Sɛ mete aseɛ yi, AWURADE Nyankopɔn asɛm nie, ampa ara, moremmu bɛ yi Israel mu bio. 4Hwɛ, akra nyinaa wɔ me. Sɛ agya kra wɔ me no, sɛ ɔba nso kra wɔ me ne no; ɔkra a ɔyɛ bɔne no, ɔno ara na ɔbɛwuo.
5Na sɛ onipa yɛ ɔteneneeni, na ɔyɛ atemmudeɛ ne ateneneedeɛ, 6#Lew 18.19-20 na ɔnni afɔreduane mmepɔ no so, na ɔmma n’ani so nhwɛ Israel fie ahoni huhuo no, na ɔngu ne yɔnko yere ho fi na ɔnkɔ ɔbaa a wayɛ bra ho, 7#Dwom 15.3; Deut 24.10-13 na ɔnhom obi so, na ɔde ɔkafoni awowasideɛ sane ma, ɔnyɛ ɔpempensini, ɔde n’aduane ma deɛ ɔdi kɔm na ɔfira ɔdagyani ntoma, 8#Eks 22.25 na ɔmmɔ bosea na ɔnnye nsiho, na ɔtwe ne nsa firi abusudeɛ ho, na ɔbu onipa ne onipa ntam atɛntenenee, 9na ɔnam m’ahyɛdeɛ mu, na ɔdi m’atemmudeɛ so di nokwasɛm a, ɔno na ɔteneneeni ne no; nkwa na ɔbɛnya, AWURADE Nyankopɔn asɛm nie.
10Na sɛ ɔwɔ ɔba korɔmfoɔ a ɔka mogya guo, na ɔyɛ yeinom mu baako pɛ, 11na ɔno ara deɛ ɔnnyɛ nnoɔma yeinom biara, (wanyɛ yeinom mu biara), na sɛ nso ɔdi afɔreduane mmepɔ no so, na ɔgu ne yɔnko yere ho fi, 12na ɔhom mmɔborɔni ne ohiani so, ɔyɛ ɔpempensideɛ nso ɔnnane mma, na ɔma n’ani so hwɛ ohoni huhuo yɛ akyiwadeɛ, 13na ɔbɔ bosea na ɔgye nsiho a, ɔbɛnya nkwa anaa? Aane, ɔrennya nkwa! Wayɛ akyiwadeɛ yi nyinaa, wuo na ɔbɛwuo, ne mogya bɛbua n’atifi.
14Na hwɛ ɔwo ɔba, na ɔno deɛ, ɔhunu n’agya bɔne a ɔyɛ nyinaa, na ɔsuro, na ɔnyɛ saa bi, 15na ɔnni afɔreduane mmepɔ no so, na ɔmma n’ani so nhwɛ Israel fie ahoni huhuo, na ɔngu ne yɔnko yere ho fi, 16na ɔnhom obi so, na ɔnnye awowasideɛ nsie, na ɔnyɛ ɔpempensini, na ɔde n’aduane ma deɛ ɛkɔm de no, ɔfira ɔdagyani ntoma, 17na ɔsianka ne nsa firi mmɔborɔni ho, na ɔnnye mfɛntomu ne nsiho, na ɔyɛ m’atemmudeɛ nam m’ahyɛdeɛ mu a, ɔno deɛ, ɔrenwu n’agya amumuyɛ mu; nkwa na ɔbɛnya. 18N’agya no, ɛnam sɛ wadi amim, asi ne nua apempem, na wayɛ deɛ ɛnyɛ, ne man mu nti hwɛ, ɔbɛwu n’amumuyɛ mu.
19Na moka sɛ: Adɛn nti na ɔba nsoa n’agya amumuyɛ bie? Na sɛ ɔba no ayɛ atemmudeɛ ne ateneneedeɛ adi m’ahyɛdeɛ nyinaa so ayɛ a, nkwa na ɔbɛnya. 20#Eks 20.5; Num 26.11 Ɔkra a ɔyɛ bɔne no, ɔno na ɔbɛwuo; ɔba rensoa n’agya amumuyɛ bi, na agya nso rensoa ne ba amumuyɛ bi; ɔteneneeni tenenee bɛtena ne so, na ɔbɔnefoɔ abɔnefosɛm bɛtena ne so.
21Na ɔbɔnefoɔ nso, sɛ ɔsane firi ne bɔne a wayɛ nyinaa ho, na ɔdi m’ahyɛdeɛ nyinaa so, yɛ atemmudeɛ a, nkwa na ɔbɛnya, ɔrenwu. 22#Yes 43.25; 44.22 Ne mmarato adeɛ a ɔyɛeɛ nyinaa, wɔrenkae mma no bio; ne tenenee a wayɛ no mu na ɔbɛnya nkwa. 23#Hes 18.32; 33.11 Pɛ na mepɛ ɔbɔnefoɔ wuo anaa? AWURADE Nyankopɔn asɛm nie; ɛnyɛ sɛ ɔsane firi ne kwan soɔ na ɔnya nkwa na mepɛ anaa? 24#Hes 3.20 Nanso sɛ ɔteneneeni sane firi ne tenenee ho kɔyɛ abusudeɛ ne akyiwadeɛ nyinaa a ɔbɔnefoɔ yɛ a, ɔbɛnya nkwa anaa? Ne tenenee a ɔyɛeɛ nyinaa, wɔrenkae; ne fom a wafom ne ne bɔne a wayɛ no mu na ɔbɛwuo.
25 # Hes 33.17-20 Nanso moka sɛ AWURADE kwan ntene. Montie ɛ, Israel fie, me kwan ntene anaa? Ɛnyɛ mo akwan na ɛntene? 26Sɛ ɔteneneeni sane firi ne tenenee ho kɔyɛ abusudeɛ, na ɔwu wɔ mu a, n’abusudeɛ a ɔyɛeɛ no mu na ɔwuiɛ. 27Nso sɛ ɔbɔnefoɔ sane firi n’abɔnefosɛm a wadie no ho bɛyɛ atemmudeɛ ne ateneneedeɛ a, ɔno deɛ, wagye ne kra nkwa. 28Na sɛ wahunu, na wasane afiri ne mmarato a ɔdiiɛ no nyinaa ho nti, nkwa na ɔbɛnya, ɔrenwu. 29Nanso Israel fie ka sɛ AWURADE kwan ntene. M’akwan ntene, Israel fie? Ɛnyɛ mo akwan na ɛntene?
30 # Hes 33.11; Yes 55.7 Ɛno nti Israel fie, mɛbu mo mo akwan ho atɛn mmaako mmaako, AWURADE Nyankopɔn asɛm nie. Monsane na monnane mo ho mfiri mo mmaratodeɛ nyinaa ho, na mmusuo anyɛ suntidua amma mo. 31Montoto mo mmaratodeɛ a mode too mmara no nyinaa mfiri mo so ngu, na monyɛ akoma foforɔ ne honhom foforɔ mfa. Na adɛn nti na ɛsɛ sɛ mowuo yi, Israel fie? 32#Hes 18.23 Na menni deɛ ɔrewuo no wuo ho anigyeɛ, AWURADE Nyankopɔn asɛm nie. Enti monsane, na mommɛnya nkwa.

Na AWURADE asɛm baa me nkyɛn sɛ: Mokyerɛ sɛn, sɛ mobu bɛ yi Israel asase so sɛ: Agyanom twɛre abunu, na mma se fem, a? Sɛ mete aseɛ yi, AWURADE Nyankopɔn asɛm nie, ampa ara, moremmu bɛ yi Israel mu bio. Hwɛ, akra nyinaa wɔ me. Sɛ agya kra wɔ me no, sɛ ɔba nso kra wɔ me ne no; ɔkra a ɔyɛ bɔne no, ɔno ara na ɔbɛwuo.
Na sɛ onipa yɛ ɔteneneeni, na ɔyɛ atemmudeɛ ne ateneneedeɛ, na ɔnni afɔreduane mmepɔ no so, na ɔmma n’ani so nhwɛ Israel fie ahoni huhuo no, na ɔngu ne yɔnko yere ho fi na ɔnkɔ ɔbaa a wayɛ bra ho, na ɔnhom obi so, na ɔde ɔkafoni awowasideɛ sane ma, ɔnyɛ ɔpempensini, ɔde n’aduane ma deɛ ɔdi kɔm na ɔfira ɔdagyani ntoma, na ɔmmɔ bosea na ɔnnye nsiho, na ɔtwe ne nsa firi abusudeɛ ho, na ɔbu onipa ne onipa ntam atɛntenenee, na ɔnam m’ahyɛdeɛ mu, na ɔdi m’atemmudeɛ so di nokwasɛm a, ɔno na ɔteneneeni ne no; nkwa na ɔbɛnya, AWURADE Nyankopɔn asɛm nie.
Na sɛ ɔwɔ ɔba korɔmfoɔ a ɔka mogya guo, na ɔyɛ yeinom mu baako pɛ, na ɔno ara deɛ ɔnnyɛ nnoɔma yeinom biara, (wanyɛ yeinom mu biara), na sɛ nso ɔdi afɔreduane mmepɔ no so, na ɔgu ne yɔnko yere ho fi, na ɔhom mmɔborɔni ne ohiani so, ɔyɛ ɔpempensideɛ nso ɔnnane mma, na ɔma n’ani so hwɛ ohoni huhuo yɛ akyiwadeɛ, na ɔbɔ bosea na ɔgye nsiho a, ɔbɛnya nkwa anaa? Aane, ɔrennya nkwa! Wayɛ akyiwadeɛ yi nyinaa, wuo na ɔbɛwuo, ne mogya bɛbua n’atifi.
Na hwɛ ɔwo ɔba, na ɔno deɛ, ɔhunu n’agya bɔne a ɔyɛ nyinaa, na ɔsuro, na ɔnyɛ saa bi, na ɔnni afɔreduane mmepɔ no so, na ɔmma n’ani so nhwɛ Israel fie ahoni huhuo, na ɔngu ne yɔnko yere ho fi, na ɔnhom obi so, na ɔnnye awowasideɛ nsie, na ɔnyɛ ɔpempensini, na ɔde n’aduane ma deɛ ɛkɔm de no, ɔfira ɔdagyani ntoma, na ɔsianka ne nsa firi mmɔborɔni ho, na ɔnnye mfɛntomu ne nsiho, na ɔyɛ m’atemmudeɛ nam m’ahyɛdeɛ mu a, ɔno deɛ, ɔrenwu n’agya amumuyɛ mu; nkwa na ɔbɛnya. N’agya no, ɛnam sɛ wadi amim, asi ne nua apempem, na wayɛ deɛ ɛnyɛ, ne man mu nti hwɛ, ɔbɛwu n’amumuyɛ mu.
Na moka sɛ: Adɛn nti na ɔba nsoa n’agya amumuyɛ bie? Na sɛ ɔba no ayɛ atemmudeɛ ne ateneneedeɛ adi m’ahyɛdeɛ nyinaa so ayɛ a, nkwa na ɔbɛnya. Ɔkra a ɔyɛ bɔne no, ɔno na ɔbɛwuo; ɔba rensoa n’agya amumuyɛ bi, na agya nso rensoa ne ba amumuyɛ bi; ɔteneneeni tenenee bɛtena ne so, na ɔbɔnefoɔ abɔnefosɛm bɛtena ne so.
Na ɔbɔnefoɔ nso, sɛ ɔsane firi ne bɔne a wayɛ nyinaa ho, na ɔdi m’ahyɛdeɛ nyinaa so, yɛ atemmudeɛ a, nkwa na ɔbɛnya, ɔrenwu. Ne mmarato adeɛ a ɔyɛeɛ nyinaa, wɔrenkae mma no bio; ne tenenee a wayɛ no mu na ɔbɛnya nkwa. Pɛ na mepɛ ɔbɔnefoɔ wuo anaa? AWURADE Nyankopɔn asɛm nie; ɛnyɛ sɛ ɔsane firi ne kwan soɔ na ɔnya nkwa na mepɛ anaa? Nanso sɛ ɔteneneeni sane firi ne tenenee ho kɔyɛ abusudeɛ ne akyiwadeɛ nyinaa a ɔbɔnefoɔ yɛ a, ɔbɛnya nkwa anaa? Ne tenenee a ɔyɛeɛ nyinaa, wɔrenkae; ne fom a wafom ne ne bɔne a wayɛ no mu na ɔbɛwuo.
Nanso moka sɛ AWURADE kwan ntene. Montie ɛ, Israel fie, me kwan ntene anaa? Ɛnyɛ mo akwan na ɛntene? Sɛ ɔteneneeni sane firi ne tenenee ho kɔyɛ abusudeɛ, na ɔwu wɔ mu a, n’abusudeɛ a ɔyɛeɛ no mu na ɔwuiɛ. Nso sɛ ɔbɔnefoɔ sane firi n’abɔnefosɛm a wadie no ho bɛyɛ atemmudeɛ ne ateneneedeɛ a, ɔno deɛ, wagye ne kra nkwa. Na sɛ wahunu, na wasane afiri ne mmarato a ɔdiiɛ no nyinaa ho nti, nkwa na ɔbɛnya, ɔrenwu. Nanso Israel fie ka sɛ AWURADE kwan ntene. M’akwan ntene, Israel fie? Ɛnyɛ mo akwan na ɛntene?
Ɛno nti Israel fie, mɛbu mo mo akwan ho atɛn mmaako mmaako, AWURADE Nyankopɔn asɛm nie. Monsane na monnane mo ho mfiri mo mmaratodeɛ nyinaa ho, na mmusuo anyɛ suntidua amma mo. Montoto mo mmaratodeɛ a mode too mmara no nyinaa mfiri mo so ngu, na monyɛ akoma foforɔ ne honhom foforɔ mfa. Na adɛn nti na ɛsɛ sɛ mowuo yi, Israel fie? Na menni deɛ ɔrewuo no wuo ho anigyeɛ, AWURADE Nyankopɔn asɛm nie. Enti monsane, na mommɛnya nkwa.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
